dct_description_sm: Dataset was originally generated with MPAC Property Codes and local knowledge to satisfy the requirement for Landmark polygons (themed land use) for the ESRI Community Maps Template as part of the Basemap Project 2010. This is a non-specific and generalized polygon feature class of themed landuses in the City. Attribute data includes landmark name, ID, Type and Subclass. This feature class continues to be updated as new developments come on line.
